text:
deploy-bot: starting rollout release-4.1.2 -> canary (10%) us-central at 7999994321. monitoring p95, error-rate, kv-cache. autopilot mode= suggest (no auto_revert for rerank route).
riley: noticed rerank p95 jump at 7999994325 on canary hosts. baseline ~40ms -> now ~180ms. dash: https://internal.metrics/redwood/4.1.2/rerank
dana: can you paste the host query?
riley: `avg_over_time(rerank_p95_ms[2m]) by (host)` shows 3 hosts consistently high.
dana: autopilot set to suggest -> manual action needed. options: (1) targeted traffic-slice rollback for rerank route (2) pause entire canary (3) quick revert. I'd prefer 1 to limit blast radius.
tim-oncall: agreed. targeted rollback + version pin for rerank route sounds right. also draft customer comms for any affected SRE contact.
riley: executing targeted traffic-set: `redwoodctl rollout traffic-set --release=release-4.1.2 --route=rerank --canary=0 --target=4.1.1`
support-bot: created ticket RED-8102 "rerank p95 regression - canary 4.1.2" and notified #support.
dana: pin command ready: `redwoodctl versions pin --route=rerank --version=4.1.1 --reason "p95 spike on 4.1.2 canary"`
riley: traffic-set completed 7999994329; rerank canary -> 0% for canary.
dana: pin applied 7999994331. `redwoodctl show pins --route=rerank` confirms pin 4.1.1 active.
support-bot: drafted customer note: "We're rolling back the rerank route to the previous stable version for a subset of traffic due to a latency regression during deployment. No data loss expected. Account teams notified." queued to affected contacts.
tim-oncall: action list: 1) dana open hotfix branch & collect heapdumps 2) riley verify metrics of pinned slice 3) support send customer note 4) tim schedule postmortem. ack?
dana: ack. opening hotfix branch `hotfix/rerank-kvcache-4.1.2` and PR with logging toggles. link: https://git.internal/redwood/hotfix/2468
riley: metrics on pinned slice stabilizing; p95 back to ~45ms at 7999994335.
tim-oncall: setting rollout state -> "rerank-targeted-pinned" and recording events. who will own RCA? dana infra, riley customer timeline.
dana: I'll take infra RCA, will attach heapdumps and kernel traces to RED-8102.
support-bot: customer messages sent 7999994336.
riley: STATUS: targeted rollback executed, rerank pinned to 4.1.1, rerank canary paused. Support & account teams notified. RCA ETA 48h. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Rollout update recorded. events: traffic_set=7999994329 pin=7999994331 notify=7999994336 state_change=7999994338.
